name: Single Room
desc: Compact and precisely appointed. The Single is designed for the solo traveller who values character over square footage — everything in reach, nothing unnecessary.

name: Standard Room
desc: The Standard is our opening argument for the hotel: quiet, hand-detailed, and more considered than the category suggests. A room that holds its own against much larger competition.

name: Double Room
desc: A room sized for two without sacrifice. The Double offers either garden or city aspect, a proper bath, and the same hand-embroidered linens found in our grandest suites.

name: Queen Room
desc: The Queen pairs a freestanding copper bath with a serene courtyard aspect — a room that invites you to stay longer than you planned.

name: King Room
desc: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Parisian roofscape. The King is our most-requested room category — generous without excess, refined without severity.

name: Deluxe Room
desc: The Deluxe is the fullest expression of a room before the step into suites. A super-king bed, panoramic outlook, and a dressing room that genuinely fits a wardrobe.

name: Executive Room
desc: Designed for extended stays and working visits. The Executive includes a purpose-built desk area, lounge access with meeting facilities, and everything needed to work without leaving the hotel.

name: Family Room
desc: Paris with children, done properly. The Family room connects a full king bedroom to a separate children's area, both opening onto a garden-facing terrace. Unhurried, spacious, and genuinely thought through.

name: Suite
desc: The Suite commands 270-degree views across the Tuileries and beyond. A private terrace, separate drawing room, and on-call butler make it the hotel's most complete residential experience short of the Penthouse.

name: Penthouse
desc: The Penthouse occupies the entire top floor. A private plunge pool, wraparound terrace, and on-call butler make it Maison's most complete expression of luxury.
